description: Abrupt switch from natural textured surface to hard black opaque box due to missing geometry across frames 24-25, followed by instant return. Produces noticeable strobe effect during playback.
1-pixel bilinear rim blend creates slight edge aliasing along homography perimeter against the vehicle bumper. Lacks depth edge feathering.

Scalar illumination gain (0.96) applies uniform brightness scaling, failing to replicate physical specular highlights, ambient reflections, or directional shadow gradients present across natural camera footage.

110-pixel shifted quadrilaterals satisfied protective bounding box checks and valid homography constraints, yet completely exposed original plate leading digits ('2025') across 72/72 frames. Detected by exported OCR.
